case_text: A 44-year-old woman presented with a 3-day history of right flank pain associated with nausea. She underwent contrast enhanced computed tomography, demonstrating a 6 cm cystic lesion in the pancreas. FNA of the cyst demonstrated no evidence of malignancy. She was diagnosed with a gastric duplication cyst after having positive Donath-Landsteiner test. She underwent a laparoscopic distal pancreatectomy. Oseltamivir 75 mg twice daily was started. The patient was discharged home on postoperative day 4.
A 7-year-old boy presented with fever. He denies chest pain. Past medical history significant for asthma. He was discharged home.
